120026.name: Keren Rachem
120026.note: Chabad.org obituary of Mrs. Miriam Rosenblum (Rochel Horowitz; on CrownHeights.info, 5 Jan 2021): 'The one she was most devoted to was "Keren Racheim," short for Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, which Mrs. Rosenblum founded and named for the wife of the Rebbe ... shortly after her passing in 1988.' Medium: 'shortly after' the Rebbetzin's passing (Feb 1988), so 1988 or soon after. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

119920.name: Gan Israel Hebrew School
119920.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director, and a web search for the older centres; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Blumie Samuels. The Hebrew school of Chabad of the Farmington Valley (Rabbi Mendel and Blumie Samuels), which began in 1998 (Jewish Ledger, 6 July 2011: 'in 1998, Rabbi Mendel Samuels was brought in to start Chabad of the Farmington Valley'; IRS ruling Sept 2002), so it began between 1998 and its chabad.org listing (July 22 2004).
